discovery_run: Final Confirmation Run (Poisson GLM with shrinkage)

metrics.name: Team card rates (home+away, w5)
metrics.description: Minimal team-specific card rate pair predicting total cards via Poisson GLM
metrics.mechanism: Team disciplinary persistence — teams that accumulate cards historically continue doing so
adversarial_concerns: Redundant with the known-good cards model

ev_test.conclusion: Marginal advantage over market at some lines (not actionable given CI width)

metrics.name: Team card rates (home w5 + away w10)
metrics.description: Mixed-window team card rates — short-term home form + longer-term away tendency
metrics.mechanism: Short-term home discipline (w5) captures recent form; longer away window (w10) captures stable away tendency
adversarial_concerns: Interaction gain over minimal pair is moderate (~1.5%)

ev_test.conclusion: Marginal advantage over market at some lines (not actionable given CI width)

metrics.name: Card rates + foul rate (b_cards_w10 + a_fouls_w5)
metrics.description: Away card tendency + home foul rate — captures foul-to-card conversion context
metrics.mechanism: Fouls-to-cards conversion rate varies by team/referee; adding foul rate captures this ratio implicitly
adversarial_concerns: Best held-out performance of all patterns
Fouls may partially proxy for match intensity

ev_test.conclusion: Marginal advantage over market at some lines (not actionable given CI width)

metrics.name: Cards triple with half-split (a_w5 + b_w10 + b_2h_w10)
metrics.description: Full card rate triple with second-half card tendency — captures late-game discipline breakdown pattern
metrics.mechanism: Second-half cards indicate teams that tire and become undisciplined as matches progress
adversarial_concerns: Discovery BSS (3.4%) degrades to held-out (2.1%) — some overfitting
Triple adds negligible gain over pair on held-out

ev_test.conclusion: Marginal advantage over market at some lines (not actionable given CI width)

metrics.name: Defensive vulnerability (SOT + xG conceded, w10)
metrics.description: Shots on target conceded + xG conceded rolling average predicting total goals via Poisson GLM
metrics.mechanism: Teams that face more shots on target and higher-xG chances concede more goals — defensive vulnerability persistence
adversarial_concerns: Goals market is heavily modeled — signal may be thin/transient

ev_test.conclusion: Signal real vs naive but already priced in by market

metrics.name: SOT conceded + goal history (w10 + w5)
metrics.description: Shots on target conceded + recent goal count predicting total goals
metrics.mechanism: Defensive vulnerability (SOT) + recent scoring environment (total goals in recent matches)
adversarial_concerns: Held-out BSS degrades significantly from discovery (1.64→0.52) — possible overfitting

ev_test.conclusion: Signal real vs naive but already priced in by market

metrics.name: Goal count + xG (w5)
metrics.description: Recent total goal count + home team xG predicting total goals
metrics.mechanism: Recent match goal environment + expected goals as quality indicators for goal production
adversarial_concerns: May just proxy for team quality

ev_test.conclusion: Signal real vs naive but already priced in by market

comparison_to_baseline.interpretation: Discovered combinations are real but weaker than the full model. Architecture (Poisson with shrinkage) contributes ~60% of the performance; feature selection contributes ~40%.

cumulative_search.note: BH correction applied across the full cumulative family, not per-run

history.run: F018 multi-source discovery (24 new fields, 3 second-tier leagues)

disagreement_test.question: In the matches where the model most disagrees with the market, who is right?
disagreement_test.method: Re-slice of the EXACT EV-test per-match model and vig-adjusted market probabilities (no substitution, no refit, no retune). Disagreement = |model_p_over - fair_market_p_over|. Per-combo quintiles (n 70-281 too thin for deciles); pooled deciles on within-combo z-scored disagreement (3088 rows from ~321 unique matches).

directional_split_top_decile.note: Both directions lose; model is WORSE on the UNDER side -> reverse of the narrative-bias prediction.

disagreement_test.lone_improves_combo: cards_minimal_pair@4.5 (corr +0.64) -- consistent with multiple-comparison risk across 17 slices; other cards metrics at 4.5 are FLAT.
disagreement_test.high_disagreement_fixture_profile: Predominantly EPL promoted/relegation-threatened/high-variance sides (Southampton, Ipswich, Wolves, Everton); NOT marquee derbies; no referee concentration. Mechanism: unreliable rolling averages on thin team histories -> model over-reacts.
disagreement_test.interpretation: FATAL. Disagreement is anti-informative: the model is most wrong exactly where it most departs from the market -- the signature of a mis-specified model, not concealed edge. Strengthens the EV-test conclusion: metrics are not merely priced-in on average, their market disagreements actively lose.
disagreement_test.caveats: Wide CIs (~30 unique matches/bucket); subset analysis on already-examined data; pooled rows non-independent. Follow-up: rerun identical disagreement-decile analysis on held-out/fresh matches with the frozen model.

ev_test_summary.conclusion: All 7 metrics fail to beat Bet365 on calibration (BSS). Signals are real vs naive but already priced in. No exploitable edge found. FOLLOW-UP (2026-08-29 disagreement test): performance DEGRADES with model-market disagreement -- metrics are anti-informative where they most disagree, not concealed edge. See disagreement_test block.
coverage_gaps: BTTS: not testable with Poisson GLM (binary target needs logistic model)
Clean sheet: not testable with Poisson GLM (binary target)

championship_slice.question: Is Bet365 sloppier on Championship than EPL, and do any metrics beat that market?
championship_slice.league_season: English Championship comp_8321, 25/26 sn_3064530 (most recent completed)
championship_slice.method: Reused ev_test model VERBATIM (Poisson GLM+L2 0.01, EB shrinkage 10, point-in-time rolling, multiplicative de-vig) via a TheStatsAPI->FootyStats schema adapter. No refit/retune/substitution. Within-season expanding-window walk-forward (single-season slice).

sanity_gate.note: Known team-card-rate->cards signal not detectable on this slice; model-side results NOT trusted.

answers.bet365_sloppier_than_epl: NO (market BSS ~0 at high-n lines, EPL-like overrounds)
answers.any_candidate_beats_market: NO (sanity gate failed; only artifact cells at small n; all ROI CIs span zero)

championship_slice.recommendation: DO NOT buy paid plan on down-tier thesis; cheap multi-season re-check available within existing ~8,660-request trial remainder.
championship_slice.caveats: Single league/season, n=200, wide CIs (all ROI CIs span zero), multiple-comparison risk. Hypothesis-level only.

generalization_followup.finding: Card-signal failure is STRUCTURAL (flat across Championship 25/26, 24/25, 23/24) and CARDS-SPECIFIC (goals persistence transfers at corpus-comparable strength; corners corpus-level).
generalization_followup.product_rule: Cards-based metrics require per-league validation; EXCLUDE Championship for cards strategies. Goals-based team signal transfers. Signal validated across ~25 leagues is not evidence it holds in a 26th.
generalization_followup.method: model-free raw-feature Spearman (no model/GLM/metric defs), rolling w5, point-in-time, full balanced seasons (46 apps/team), per season never pooled
